UpdateSourceArgs: -c "set -e; src=\"{{BuildSourcePath}}\"; dst=\"{{$FullBaseDir}}\"; case \"$dst\" in */respark/server/) ;; *) echo \"Refusing to replace unexpected folder $dst\"; exit 1;; esac; if [ ! -f \"$src/ResparkServer.x86_64\" ]; then echo \"No ResparkServer.x86_64 in $src - set Build Source Folder under Updates\"; exit 1; fi; rm -rf \"$dst\"; mkdir -p \"$dst\"; cp -a \"$src/.\" \"$dst\"; chmod +x \"$dst/ResparkServer.x86_64\"; [ -f \"$dst/steam_appid.txt\" ] || echo 5177480 > \"$dst/steam_appid.txt\"; echo \"Copied Respark server from $src\""
